preconditions.description: The number of files is between 1 and 500, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each file name is a string with at least 1 and at most 8 lower case letters 'a' to 'z'.
preconditions.description: The names of the files are given on the second line and are valid file names.

preconditions.expression: Each import statement is followed by at least one file name.
preconditions.description: Each import statement in the sections is valid and contains at least one file name.

preconditions.expression: No file imports the same file more than once.
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate imports within any file's import statements.

preconditions.expression: Every file imported is listed in the second line of the input.
preconditions.description: All imported files are among the names listed on the second line.

postconditions.expression: If the code base has no cyclic dependencies, output “SHIP IT”.
postconditions.description: The output is either a list of file names representing a cycle or the string “SHIP IT” if there are no cycles.

postconditions.expression: Otherwise, output a line containing the names of files in a shortest cycle, in the order of the cycle.
postconditions.description: If there is a cycle, the output is a list of file names that form the shortest cycle, starting with the first file in the cycle and ending with the last file in the cycle.
